paite: TOUPA phat un. TOUPA min phat un; TOUPA Sikhate aw, amah phat un.
heading: Pathian Hoihna Leh Hatna Phatna La

paite: Nou TOUPA' inn a dingh a, Pathian inn huangsung intual a dinghte aw,
TOUPA phat un; TOUPA lah ahoih ngal a; amin phat in la sa un, anuam mahmah ngal a!
TOUPA'N amah a ding in Jakob atelta a, agou tuam ding in Israel atel hi.
TOUPA thupitak ahi chih leh, pathian tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi chih, i thei ngal uhi.
TOUPA'N a-ut peuhmah, van ah, lei ah, tuipi ah, tui thukpite ah ahih hi.
Ama'n meipite kawlmong a kipan in apaitousak a; vuah in khophiate asiam hi; akoihkhawmna a kipan huih alakhia hi.
Ama'n Aigupta gam ta masate athat a, mihing leh sate leng.
Aigupta gam aw, amah chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na sung ah ahon sawl a, Pharaoh tung ah leh asikhate tung ah.
Ama'n nam tampi athat a, kumpipa thupi taktakte athat hi.
Sihon Amorte kumpipa leh Og Bashan gam kumpipa leh, Kanaan gam a mi tengteng.
Agam uh gouluah ding in apia a, ami Israelte goutan ding in.
TOUPA aw, na min tangtawn in a-om ding a; TOUPA aw, nangmah theihgigena suan om sung teng in leng a-om ding hi.
TOUPA'N amite vai ahawmsak in, asikhate tung ah lainatna anei ding hi.
Namte milimte dangka leh dangka-eng ahi ua, mihing khutsuak ahi uh.
Kam anei ua, himahleh apau kei uh; mitte anei ua, himahleh amu thei kei uh;
Bilte anei ua, himahleh aza thei kei uh; akam uah hatna a-om sam kei hi.
Amau bawlte amaute bang in a-om ding uh, huaite gingta peuhmahte.
Israel inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un! Aaron inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un!
Levi inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un! TOUPA lau mite aw, TOUPA phat un!
TOUPA Zion a kipan phat in om hen, Jerusalem a tengpa ngei, TOUPA phat un!
